oi_delta_clusters.note_en: Neither of the two most recent stored chain snapshots lists this name, though earlier snapshots do, so no current open-interest change is available for it. Per-strike chain snapshots begin 2026-06-15, so this record is still short.
oi_delta_clusters.note_zh: 最近两次期权链快照都不包含本标的（较早的快照有），因此目前无法提供其未平仓量变化。逐行权价期权链快照自 2026-06-15 起累积，记录仍然很短。

regime_passport.note: dealer long-call/short-put sign is an unobservable assumption; single-name gamma regime is a near-constant product attribute, not a time-varying signal (validator MIN_PER_BUCKET structurally unreachable)

reliability.note: Direction soft — sign not NBBO-confirmed. All levels are descriptive maps, not forecasts.

wall_persistence.basis_en: This level is the heaviest open interest in the snapshot source's full contract list. The board's own call and put walls are dollar-gamma levels taken from a narrower window of a different chain source, so the two often land on different strikes.
wall_persistence.basis_zh: 此水平取自快照来源完整合约列表中未平仓量最重的行权价。本板块自身的看涨/看跌墙是另一个期权链来源、在更窄区间内计算的美元 Gamma 水平，因此两者经常落在不同的行权价上。

call_side.note_en: No call-side open-interest level is stored for this name yet.
call_side.note_zh: 本标的暂无看涨未平仓量水平记录。

put_side.note_en: No put-side open-interest level is stored for this name yet.
put_side.note_zh: 本标的暂无看跌未平仓量水平记录。

wall_persistence.spot_note_en: Strike distances here are measured against the snapshot source's price of 41.66, which differs from this board's price by 18.5%.
wall_persistence.spot_note_zh: 此处的行权价距离以快照来源的价格 41.66 为基准，与本板块价格相差 18.5%。
